basics.name: Julien Tang
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: PhD student in cosmology, working on data simulations and data analysis pipelines for next-generation CMB experiments. Working on mapmaking methods to minimize atmospheric contamination. Member of the CMB-S4 collaboration.

work.name: Laboratoire AstroParticule et Cosmologie, 75013 Paris, France (UMR 7164)
work.summary: PhD Student in Cosmology under Jacques Delabrouille and Michel Piat. Pipeline development for next-generation CMB surveys, with a focus on atmospheric noise mitigation. Optimal internal delensing of CMB B-modes

work.name: Center for Computational Cosmology, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
work.summary: Master's Thesis work under Jacques Delabrouille and Reijo Keskitalo. Comparison of mapmaking pipelines for a CMB-S4 like SAT from Chile.

work.name: Kavli Institute for the Physics and Mathematics of the Universe (IPMU), The University of Tokyo, Japan
work.summary: Research Internship under Josquin Errard and Tomotake Matsumura. Reconstruction of Inflationary CMB B-mode Signal in the Presence of Instrumental Effects and Galactic Foreground Emissions.

awards.title: International Physicists’ Tournament’s 14th edition
awards.summary: The International Physicists' Tournament (IPT) is a physics competition for undergraduate students, bachelors or master level (or equivalent), in which students representing their nation and institution have typically 9 months to solve a set of challenging unsolved physics problems, then present and defend them to other teams.

fellowships.title: Full PhD Scholarship
fellowships.awarder: École Doctorale de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris
fellowships.summary: Doctoral fellowship supporting graduate studies in physics, 2024–2027.

fellowships.title: Erasmus+ Mobility Grant
fellowships.summary: International mobility grant for research and academic exchange, 2023.

talks.name: Probing Inflation with PICO: Simulations and Delensing for CMB B-Modes
talks.conference: COLOURS (Cosmological Surveys and Synergies) Workshop, Orsay
talks.summary: Invited talk on PICO mission simulations and delensing techniques for the measurement of CMB B-modes, presented at the COLOURS workshop in Orsay.
